title: Why Solapur is famous for terry towels
summary: Solapur in Maharashtra is one of India's best-known towel centres, and Solapur Terry Towel is a registered GI product. Here is what that means for buyers.
body:
Ask a towel wholesaler anywhere in India where good terry towels come from, and Solapur is usually the first answer. This city in Maharashtra has made cotton textiles for generations, first chaddars and then terry towels, and today it is one of the country's best-known towel centres.

## A registered Geographical Indication

**Solapur Terry Towel** is a registered Geographical Indication (GI) of India, registered in 2005, alongside **Solapuri Chaddar**. A GI is a legal mark for products whose quality and reputation come from the place they are made, like Darjeeling tea or Kanchipuram silk. It recognises that Solapur's towel-making skill is tied to the region and its weavers.

## What makes Solapur towels different

- **Skilled weavers and finishers.** Generations of experience in terry weaving, dyeing and finishing.
- **A complete supply chain in one city.** Yarn, dyeing, weaving, stitching and packing all happen nearby, which keeps costs competitive.
- **Wide variety.** Plain, dobby border, jacquard, striped and checked designs, in every common size from face towels to large bath towels.
- **Made for bulk.** Solapur manufacturers are used to supplying wholesalers, hotels and retailers across India.

## Buying direct from a Solapur manufacturer

Buying from the manufacturer instead of a trader gives you factory pricing, consistent quality from batch to batch, and the option to ask for specific sizes, weights or colours.

Vijayalaxmi Textiles has made cotton textiles in Solapur since 1982 and sells terry towels under our registered brand **Shegur's®**. See [our towels](/towels/) or read more about [Solapur towels](/solapur-towels/).

title: Bath towel, hand towel and face towel: sizes and uses explained
summary: The standard bath towel is 30 × 60 inches. Here are all the common towel sizes in inches and centimetres, and what each one is for.
body:
Towel names can be confusing, especially when buying in bulk. Here is a simple guide to the common terry towel sizes used in India, and what each one is for.

## Bath towel

The largest towel in a set, used to dry the whole body.

- **Standard: 30 × 60 inches (76 × 152 cm).** The most popular size for homes, hotels and retail.
- **Large: 36 × 72 inches (91 × 183 cm).** Also called a bath sheet. Extra coverage for taller people and premium hotel rooms.

## Baby bath towel

Smaller and lighter, sized for babies and young children.

- **24 × 48 inches (61 × 122 cm)**
- **20 × 40 inches (51 × 102 cm)**

## Hand towel

Used to dry hands and face in washrooms, kitchens, salons, gyms and offices.

- **16 × 24 inches (41 × 61 cm)**, the standard hand towel
- **14 × 21 inches (36 × 53 cm)**, a smaller, lighter option

## Face towel

The smallest towel, used as a face cloth, wash cloth or napkin.

- **12 × 18 inches (30 × 46 cm)**
- **12 × 12 inches (30 × 30 cm)**, the classic square face cloth

## Bath mat

A dense terry mat for the bathroom floor.

- **20 × 30 inches (51 × 76 cm)**

## Which sizes make a set?

A typical hotel room set is one bath towel, one hand towel and one face towel per guest, plus a bath mat. Homes often buy the same combination in matching designs.

See every size side by side in our [towel size guide](/towel-size-guide/), or browse [bath towels](/towels/bath-towels/) and [hand towels](/towels/hand-towels/).

title: How to buy towels wholesale: a checklist for retailers and hotels
summary: What to decide before you ask for a towel quotation: sizes, weight, material, design, quantity and packing.
body:
A clear requirement gets you a faster and more accurate quotation. Before you contact a towel manufacturer, decide these six things.

## 1. Towel types and sizes

List each towel and its size in inches, for example bath towel 30 × 60, hand towel 16 × 24 and face towel 12 × 12. Our [towel size guide](/towel-size-guide/) lists every common size.

## 2. Weight or GSM

Weight decides how thick the towel feels and most of its price. You can ask by weight per piece (for example 400 g for a 30 × 60 bath towel) or by GSM. Lighter towels dry faster and cost less. Heavier towels feel plush. Read our [terry towel guide](/terry-towels/) if you are unsure.

## 3. Material

Cotton terry absorbs best. Blended yarns can lower the price. Microfiber is very light and quick-drying.

## 4. Design and colours

Plain, dobby border, jacquard, striped or printed, and which colours. Hotels usually choose plain or dobby-border towels in white or light shades. Retail buyers often want an assortment of bright colours.

## 5. Quantity

Give a quantity for each size and colour. Bigger orders usually get better rates, so mention if you will order regularly.

## 6. Packing and delivery

Say how you want towels packed (for example 10 pieces per bundle) and your delivery city.

## Send it in one message

Put all six points in one WhatsApp message and you will usually get a full quotation in a single reply. You can [send your requirement to us](/contact/), or download our catalogue from the [towels page](/towels/).

title: Cotton vs microfiber towels: which should you stock?
summary: Cotton terry and microfiber towels suit different buyers. Here is how they compare on absorbency, feel, drying time and price.
body:
Most towels sold in India are either cotton terry or microfiber. Both have a place, and many shops and hotels stock both.

## Cotton terry towels

Cotton terry towels have loops of cotton yarn on the surface that soak up water.

- **Absorbency:** excellent, and improves after the first few washes.
- **Feel:** soft and natural, comfortable on skin.
- **Drying time:** slower than microfiber, especially heavier towels.
- **Best for:** homes, hotels, baby towels, face towels, and anyone who wants a classic towel.

## Microfiber towels

Microfiber towels are made from very fine synthetic fibres.

- **Absorbency:** high for their weight.
- **Feel:** smooth and light. Some people prefer cotton against the skin.
- **Drying time:** very fast, and they pack small.
- **Best for:** gyms, travel, sports, beauty salons and quick-drying needs.

## Which should you stock?

If your customers are homes, hotels and families, cotton terry is the safe choice. If they are gyms, travellers or salons, add microfiber. Many retailers keep cotton as their main range and microfiber as an add-on.

We manufacture cotton terry towels in Solapur and also supply selected microfiber towels. Each product page shows the material and country of origin. See [all our towels](/towels/).
